product_overview: GovSentinel is an on-chain AI governance proposal audit console that helps DAO stewards inspect proposal intent against raw EVM calldata. It decodes execution payloads, highlights discrepancies, and presents a multi-validator consensus verdict.
core_goals: Select a benchmark governance scenario to preload proposal data
Review and edit proposal details and calldata before auditing
Run a consensus audit to assess proposal risk and validity
Inspect decoded calldata, discrepancies, and final verdict results

features.name: Benchmark Preset Selection
features.description: Users can load predefined governance scenarios to quickly populate proposal fields for review and auditing.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click a benchmark preset -> See proposal title, intent description, target contract, recipient, claimed amount, and hex calldata populate automatically
Navigate to / -> Click a different benchmark preset -> See all proposal inputs update to match the selected scenario

features.name: Proposal Submission & Validation
features.description: Users can manually adjust proposal inputs and submit them for multi-validator analysis.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Modify the proposal title and intent description -> Modify the target contract, recipient, claimed amount, or hex calldata -> Run the multi-validator consensus audit -> See the audit begin processing
Navigate to / -> Enter an invalid or mismatched proposal detail -> Run the multi-validator consensus audit -> See the proposal evaluated with a rejection, flag, or other non-passed verdict

features.name: Verdict & Consensus Output Display
features.description: Users can review the audit outcome, including the verdict, risk score, decoded calldata, discrepancies, and consensus progress.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Run the multi-validator consensus audit -> See the verdict badge update to PASSED, VETOED, or FLAGGED -> See the risk score gauge animate to the final rating -> Inspect the decoded calldata table and discrepancy list -> Track the consensus pipeline stages complete in order
Navigate to / -> Load a preset scenario -> Run the multi-validator consensus audit -> See the decoded method, recipient, amount, and whitelist status update based on the submitted calldata

routes.description: Main GovSentinel Audit Console and multi-validator consensus dashboard

features.name: Governance Proposal Calldata Audit
features.description: Analyze and verify DAO proposals and raw EVM execution calldata against human intent
user_interactions: Click benchmark preset buttons (Benign Grant, Trojan Drain, Stealth Hijack, Unapproved Target)
Enter or modify Proposal Title and Intent Description
Enter or modify Target Contract, Recipient, and Claimed Amount
Click Run Multi-Validator Consensus Audit button
See real-time verdict badge update to PASSED, VETOED, or FLAGGED
See circular Risk Score gauge animate and update
Inspect decoded calldata table (method, recipient, amount, whitelist status)
